assumptions: cvvdp -> CpuCvvdpDisplayScorer::score (cvvdp_cpu.rs:52-80) -> cvvdp::Cvvdp::score -> score_internal ~ host_scalar::still_3ch_q_per_ch (host_scalar.rs:81-250): sRGB->display-DKL (3 LUT + s*lin+bias fma + 3x3 matrix), 6x Gaussian pyramid builds (img+luma planes x3 ch), Weber contrast bands, per-band CSF sensitivity LUT interp x3 ch, masked mutual difference, lp_norm(2) per band x3, pool betas -> JOD.
n_levels = min(max_band+1, log2(min(W,H))-1): ~8 at 1024+ for ppd=75.4 (band_frequencies kernels/pyramid.rs:272-297).

gausspyr_reduce_scalar (pyramid.rs:57-140): 5-tap GAUSS5 separable; per OUT px ~ 5mul+4add h + 5mul+4add v (+ edge fixups) => mul10 add9 load10 store1 per out elem; built for BOTH image and l_bkg planes x3 ch => 6 pyramid chains.
gausspyr_expand_scalar (~180-226): zero-insert + 5-tap + *2, 2 passes => ~mul11 add9 load5 store1 per out px; 2 expands per non-baseband level per pyramid (img + l_bkg).
Per-band contrast (pyramid.rs:455-505): layer=fine-expand (sub), l_bkg max0.01 (cmp), div, clamp -1000..1000 (2cmp), log10 -> mul0 add1 div1 cmp3 log1 per px.

Sensitivity (csf.rs:167-224): per px per band per ch: log10(rho) cached? no - rho scalar per band; per px: N_L_BKG-row interp1 over rho axis (each ~4 ops + row read) + interp1 over l_bkg + powf(10^log_s) + correction mul => ~ mul25 add25 pow1 log1 (log10 rho is per-band). x3 ch.
t_p/r_p (host_scalar.rs:204-212): 6 muls per px (band_mul*s*CH_GAIN per ch per side).

mult_mutual_band (masking.rs:46-140,~180-230): per px per ch — min-abs blur sigma3 13-tap separable (26mul+24add+26load+2store incl fused min/abs/scale) + fold: term=(m+eps)^q-epsq (add+pow+sub), pw=(|t-r|+eps)^p-epsp (sub+abs+add+pow+sub), XCM 3x3 (9mul+6add), du/(1+m) div + D_MAX/(D+du) (mul+add+div) => per px(all 3ch): mul~ 90 add~90 pow6 div6 abs3.
lp_norm BETA_SPATIAL=2 per band x3 (pool.rs:141-148): safe_pow_lp = abs+add+powf ~ pow3 add4 abs3 per px + f32 sum.
Baseband: mean log_l + diff.abs()*s x3 (~sens still per-px) — counted as band stage at level NL-1.
Final pool (pool.rs:267-292): per-band weights x3 + 2 lp_norm_sum over ~8 + met2jod — scalar, ~100 ops total.

stages.name: sRGB->DKL planar x2
stages.notes: LUT linearize + DKL matrix per channel

stages.name: gauss pyr reduce v-pass (3 chains/side)
stages.notes: build_one_side_recycle: 3 chains/side (achro->gauss_l shared, rg, vy) NOT per-channel img+l; fused kernel but v-phase work counted at input column positions

stages.name: gauss pyr reduce h-pass
stages.notes: 5-tap h at output size; writes pyramid level

stages.name: shared gauss_l expand v
stages.notes: fill_l_expands: ONE expand chain per side shared by all 3 channels (pipeline.rs:3120+)

stages.name: achro weber band + log_l_bkg
stages.notes: same_img_l: no img expand; band=(fine-exp_l)/max(l_bkg,0.01) clamp ±1000; log_l_bkg written ref side only (map2_3/vweber_band_into)

stages.name: chroma fused expand+weber x2ch
stages.notes: gausspyr_expand_weber: expand taps fused + (fine-e)/max(exp_l,0.01) clamp; expanded img plane never materialized (write_log=false branch)

stages.name: baseband fine/mean + ref log fill
stages.notes: l_bkg_mean = sum(max(l,0.01))/n then fine/mean; ref fills log band

stages.name: apply_csf_pairs per level
stages.notes: 3ch x ref/dist pairs; logs_row rho-axis table hoisted per band (precompute_logs_row); shared log_l bracket

stages.name: apply_csf_diffs baseband only
stages.notes: baseband diffs path instead of pairs

stages.name: sigma3 13-tap mask blur h (min|T|,|R|+scale fused)
stages.notes: gaussian_blur_sigma3_minabs_scaled: min(|T|,|R|) folded into h-pass read + mask_c_lin scale; per channel

stages.name: sigma3 13-tap mask blur v
stages.notes: v pass writes scaled blur into term_* scratch

stages.name: mutual masking fold
stages.notes: MASK_Q pow terms + XCM_3X3 cross-channel + CH_GAIN; d_* written per channel

stages.name: pool_band_3ch
stages.notes: safe_pow_lp accumulation per channel incl. baseband
